title: StrengthBlocker
description: A plugin that disables the Strength 1/2 effect.
body:
A plugin that disables the Strength 1/2 effect.

# Commands
- /strength 1/2 on/off 

In some projects, the “Strength” effect is disabled, but most cannot completely remove it—which is why our plugin is the best solution. We can disable ‘Strength’ however you like; you can choose whether to disable “Strength 1” or “Strength 2,” or you can disable both.
